requirements.normative_requirement: The privileged guest launcher is separate from the unprivileged protocol and structured-tool broker.
requirements.threat_or_failure: Privileged parser and broker too large
requirements.primary_verification: Binary/component boundary review and privilege separation integration tests.

requirements.normative_requirement: The privileged launcher accepts no arbitrary paths, shell text, policy expressions, environment maps, or mount specifications.
requirements.primary_verification: Fuzz/negative corpus for paths, env, mount, shell, and policy fields.

requirements.normative_requirement: Workload cells cannot reach, signal, ptrace, modify, or impersonate the launcher or control channel.
requirements.primary_verification: UID, proc, ptrace, signal, mount, FD, and channel reachability tests.

requirements.normative_requirement: The host daemon self-restricts ambient authority using effective systemd and Landlock controls where supported and reports them.
requirements.threat_or_failure: Trusted daemon compromise exposes host home
requirements.primary_verification: Systemd/Landlock effective readback and denied-host-path canaries.
